residual_risks_and_limits: PROPOSAL ONLY. No production source, schema, lifecycle/admission owner, lockfile or repository tests changed.

Actual PostgreSQL SQL/row locks are real; source modules were transpiled from exact Git blobs, proposed code loaded only from /tmp. Fixture schema installs actual queue DDL plus minimal transcript/admission/event tables/FKs needed by executed functions. No provider/native calls.

Accepted transcript append now uses actual PostgresTranscriptRepository, not prior noop. Archive helpers and unrelated types are module fixtures but are not called. Reserve downstream is explicit abort boundary after actual lock acquisition, so no full reservation acceptance claim.

Proposed session gate serializes existing session owners; it is not a new product authority or separate lock registry. Sorted whole-batch session locks are required; per-event prelock could cross-lock multiple sessions.

Task/session residual source-order risk: ensureSessionWithClient upserts task before session, while admission already holds session then calls transcript task UPSERT; archive takes task then session. This ordering predates the proposed queue fix and is not reproduced by these bounded schedules. Exact owner coordination required; no universal deadlock-freedom claim.
Direct bulk import/archive/delete transaction paths and harness-control-plane external lock graphs are outside executed evidence; keep their owner scope and do not extend fix silently.
Fixture applied event carries controlled modelStep/contextRevision solely to test canonical SQL projection. This is not native/provider Applied proof.
JSONB image-fingerprint repair is a separate owned steering track; this proposal does not change content/fingerprint semantics.
